The wearer also interacted with a tortilla and grill, as seen when placing and picking up the tortilla on the grill. Additionally, the camera wearer interacted with a spatula and a cup, as observed when picking up the spatula and placing it on the counter, and when picking up a cup from the table. The television was also interacted with, as the camera wearer looked at it. No other technology objects were explicitly mentioned or observed in the video.
